name: Numerical Analysis and Computation
description: Floating point representation, floating point arithmetic, and roundoff errors. Roots of a nonlinear equation in one variable. Direct and iterative methods for linear system of equations, Condition number and ill-conditioned systems. Solutions of nonlinear system of equations. Interpolation: Lagrange, Newton’s interpolations, and errors in interpolation. Approximation: least square approximations, QR Decomposition, Continuous least square, Legendre, Chebyshev’s polynomials, Fourier Series. Numerical differentiation: Finite difference formulas and errors. Numerical integration: Newton-Cotes formulas, Gauss quadrature rules. Numerical methods for Initial value problem for ODEs
